arxiv-1907-11817.title: Scalable Source Code Similarity Detection in Large Code Repositories Publication type: Research Article/Editorial
arxiv-1907-11817.creator: Firas Alomari \fnoteref 1 Muhammed Harbi
arxiv-1907-11817.description: Abstract Source code similarity are increasingly used in application development to identify clones, isolate bugs, and find copy-rights violations. Similar code fragments can be very problematic due to the fact that errors in the original code must be fixed in every copy. Other maintenance changes, such as extensions or patches, must be applied multiple times.

arxiv-2108-11020.title: logarithmic Euler-Maruyama scheme for multi-dimensional stochastic delay equations with jumps
arxiv-2108-11020.creator: Nishant Agrawal, Yaozhong Hu
arxiv-2108-11020.description: Abstract 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 60H05; Secondary 60G51, 60H30 1. Introduction In [ 2 ] we introduced a logarithmic Euler-Maruyama scheme for a single stochastic delay equation, which preserve positivity if the solution to the original equation is positive. The convergence rate was also obtained for such scheme.

arxiv-2111-08590.title: Machine Learning for Real-Time Processing of ATLAS Liquid Argon Calorimeter Signals with FPGAs Copyright [2018] CERN for the benefit of the [ATLAS Collaboration]. CC-BY-4.0 license.
arxiv-2111-08590.creator: N. CHIEDDE
arxiv-2111-08590.description: Abstract The ATLAS experiment at CERN measures energy of proton-proton (p-p) collisions with a repetition frequency of 40 MHz at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC). The readout electronics of liquid-argon (LAr) calorimeters are being prepared for high luminosity-LHC (HL-LHC) operation as part of the phase-II upgrade, anticipating a pileup of up to 200 simultaneous p–p interactions.

arxiv-2209-03072.title: On Plane Subgraphs of Complete Topological Drawings
arxiv-2209-03072.creator: Alfredo García, Alexander Pilz, Javier Tejel ∗
arxiv-2209-03072.description: Abstract Topological drawings are representations of graphs in the plane, where vertices are represented by points, and edges by simple curves connecting the points. A drawing is simple if two edges intersect at most in a single point, either at a common endpoint or at a proper crossing.

arxiv-2302-07782.title: Multi-graded Featherweight Java
arxiv-2302-07782.creator: Riccardo Bianchini, Francesco Dagnino, Paola Giannini, Elena Zucca
arxiv-2302-07782.description: Abstract Resource-aware type systems statically approximate not only the expected result type of a program, but also the way external resources are used, e.g., how many times the value of a variable is needed. We extend the type system of Featherweight Java to be resource-aware, parametrically on an arbitrary grade algebra modeling a specific usage of resources.

arxiv-2404-03307.title: Bi-level Trajectory Optimization on Uneven Terrains with Differentiable Wheel-Terrain Interaction Model.
arxiv-2404-03307.creator: Amith Manoharan, Aditya Sharma, Himani Belsare, Kaustab Pal, K. Madhava Krishna, Arun Kumar Singh
arxiv-2404-03307.description: Abstract Navigation of wheeled vehicles on uneven terrain necessitates going beyond the 2D approaches for trajectory planning. Specifically, it is essential to incorporate the full 6 ​ d ​ o ​ f 6dof variation of vehicle pose and its associated stability cost in the planning process.

arxiv-2405-18522.title: Star Stream Velocity Distributions in CDM and WDM Galactic Halos Gadget4: Springel et al. 2021 , Amiga Halo Finder: ( Gill et al. 2004 ; Knollmann & Knebe 2009 )
arxiv-2405-18522.creator: Raymond G. Carlberg, Adrian Jenkins, Carlos S. Frenk, Andrew P. Cooper
arxiv-2405-18522.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Raymond G. Carlberg, Adrian Jenkins, Carlos S. Frenk, Andrew P. Cooper. The dark matter subhalos orbiting in a galactic halo perturb the orbits of stars in thin stellar streams. Over time the random velocities in the streams develop non-Gaussian wings. The rate of velocity increase is approximately a random walk at a rate proportional to the number of subhalos, primarily those in the mass range ≈ 10 6 − 7 ​ M ⊙ \approx 10^{6-7}M_{\odot} .

arxiv-2409-09861.title: Quantum-classical hybrid dynamics: coupling mechanisms and diffusive approximation
arxiv-2409-09861.creator: Adrián A. Budini
arxiv-2409-09861.description: Abstract In this paper we demonstrate that any Markovian master equation defining a completely positive evolution for a quantum-classical hybrid state can always be written in terms of four basic coupling mechanisms. Each of them is characterized by a different “backaction” on each subsystem.

arxiv-2411-04241.title: Non-Classicality and Non-adiabaticity in a Single Trapped Ion
arxiv-2411-04241.creator: C. F. P. Avalos, M. C. de Oliveira
arxiv-2411-04241.description: Abstract Trapped ion systems present non-classical characteristics such as squeezed states that show a quantum advantage in quantum sensing, quantum information processing and quantum thermodynamics. We analyze the non-classical characteristics of a system described by a single ion trapped by a periodic potential field.

arxiv-2412-00909.title: Centre mode instability of a dilute particle-laden swirling jet in a swirl flow combustor
arxiv-2412-00909.creator: Srikumar Warrier, Gaurav Tomar
arxiv-2412-00909.description: Abstract Linear stability of a locally parallel annular swirling jet laden with particles in a swirl flow combustor is considered. At low Stokes numbers, the eigenspectra of the particle-laden jet with uniform particle concentration shows three unstable modes namely centre, sinuous and varicose modes.

arxiv-2501-14127.title: Excitations of gauge bosons, and other aspects of gauge Higgs theories
arxiv-2501-14127.description: Abstract I review the qualitative physical distinction between the Higgs and confinement phases of a gauge Higgs theory, and the non-local order parameter introduced by Matsuyama and myself which identifies the two phases. I then present some new results suggestive of a possible excitation spectrum of vector bosons in the electroweak sector of the Standard Model.

arxiv-2502-06167.title: Universal Approximation of Visual Autoregressive Transformers
arxiv-2502-06167.creator: Yifang Chen, Xiaoyu Li, Yingyu Liang, Zhenmei Shi, Zhao Song
arxiv-2502-06167.description: Abstract We investigate the fundamental limits of transformer-based foundation models, extending our analysis to include Visual Autoregressive (VAR) transformers. VAR represents a big step toward generating images using a novel, scalable, coarse-to-fine “next-scale prediction” framework. These models set a new quality bar, outperforming all previous methods, including Diffusion Transformers, while having state-of-the-art performance for image synthesis tasks.

arxiv-2502-07115.title: Online Scheduling for LLM Inference with KV Cache Constraints
arxiv-2502-07115.creator: Patrick Jaillet, Jiashuo Jiang, Konstantina Mellou, Marco Molinaro, Chara Podimata, Zijie Zhou
arxiv-2502-07115.description: Abstract Large Language Model (LLM) inference, where a trained model generates text one word at a time in response to user prompts, is a computationally intensive process requiring efficient scheduling to optimize latency and resource utilization. A key challenge in LLM inference is the management of the Key-Value (KV) cache, which reduces redundant computations but introduces memory constraints.

The disease spread is limited by eradication of affected vines and control of S. titanus populations using insecticides. Recent studies highlighted that epidemic (transmitted by S.

pmc-11428716.title: The Link between Endogenous Pain Modulation Changes and Clinical Improvement in Fibromyalgia Syndrome: A Meta-Regression Analysis
pmc-11428716.creator: Kevin Pacheco-Barrios, Rafaela Machado Filardi, Luis Fernando González-González, Nayeon Park, Fernanda Queiroz Petrus, Alba Navarro-Flores, Silvia Di-Bonaventura, Luana Gola Alves, Fernanda Queiroz, Felipe Fregni
pmc-11428716.description: Conditioned pain modulation (CPM) and temporal summation (TS) tests can measure the ability to inhibit pain in fibromyalgia syndrome (FMS) patients and its level of pain sensitization, respectively. However, their clinical validity is still unclear. We studied the association between changes in the CPM and TS tests and the clinical improvement of FMS patients who received therapeutic intervention.

pmc-12339136.title: The Expanding Burden of Neurodegenerative Diseases: An Unmet Medical and Social Need
pmc-12339136.creator: Shu Wang, Yin Jiang, Anchao Yang, Fangang Meng, Jianguo Zhang
pmc-12339136.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Neurodegenerative diseases, particularly Alzheimer’s disease and other dementias as well as Parkinson’s disease, are emerging as profoundly significant challenges and burdens to global health, a trend highlighted by the most recent Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 studies. This growing impact is closely linked to the demographic shift toward an aging population and the potential long-term repercussions of the COVID-19 pandemic, both of which have intensified the prevalence and severity of these conditions.

pmc-12641738.title: N-Glycosylation of Antibodies: Biological Effects During Infections and Therapeutic Applications
pmc-12641738.creator: Jessica Castañeda-Casimiro, Luis Vallejo-Castillo, Eliud S. Peregrino, Alejandro Hernández-Solis, Luis Vázquez-Flores, Rommel Chacón-Salinas, Isabel Wong-Baeza, Jeanet Serafín-López
pmc-12641738.description: Antibodies are produced by cells of the adaptive immune response and recognize epitopes of microbial structures with high affinity and specificity. Antibodies are recognized by Fc fragment receptors (FcRs) found on the surface of phagocytic cells (neutrophils, monocytes, macrophages) and NK cells, among others. Hence, antibodies link the adaptive immune response with the innate immune response.

pmc-13266743.title: Understanding the link between lipid and ocular disorders for effective therapy
pmc-13266743.creator: Muhammad Zulfiqah Sadikan, Haryati Ahmad Hairi, Lidawani Lambuk
pmc-13266743.description: Cholesterol is an essential lipid for cellular integrity and metabolic homeostasis; however, dysregulated cholesterol metabolism is increasingly recognized as a key contributor to multiple ocular diseases. Beyond its established role in cardiovascular pathology, emerging evidence implicates altered lipoprotein balance, impaired cholesterol transport, and lipid-driven inflammation in the pathogenesis of age-related macular degeneration, retinal vascular diseases, cataracts, and glaucoma.

pmc-13285407.title: Enhancing seizure prediction using a DC-SA-EBiLSTM framework with self-attention mechanism
pmc-13285407.creator: Shunyun Wang, Jincan Zhang, Wenna Chen, Fei Xiang, Hongwei Jiang, Ganqin Du
pmc-13285407.description: BackgroundAccurately predicting seizures remains challenging. With advances in smart medical technology, EEG-based monitoring has become essential. This study aims to improve prediction accuracy using a hybrid framework that models multiscale EEG characteristics.MethodsEEG signals are decomposed into multiple sub-bands using the Discrete Wavelet Transform, and representative time-frequency and nonlinear features are extracted.

uslaw-usc-t10-s12523.title: 10 U.S.C. § 12523 — Risk insured
uslaw-usc-t10-s12523.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s12523.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel Generally); Chapter 1214 (Ready Reserve Mobilization Income Insurance). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— The insurance program shall insure members of the Ready Reserve against the risk of being ordered into covered service. (b) Entitlement to Benefits.— (1) An insured member ordered into covered service shall be entitled to payment.

uslaw-usc-t16-s450oo8.title: 16 U.S.C. § 450oo–8 — Advisory assistance for developments upon adjacent lands
uslaw-usc-t16-s450oo8.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s450oo8.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LXI (National And International Monuments And Memorials). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. To the extent that appropriated funds and personnel are available therefor, the Secretary of the Interior shall provide consultative or advisory assistance to the Minnesota Chippewa Tribe and the Grand Portage Band of Chippewa.
